content.short: Maxity is the first Web3 social impact protocol that helps charities and NGOs in fundraising.
content.description: Maxity leverages blockchain technology to modernize NGO fundraising and enhance sector transparency. It integrates Metaverse, NFTs, Volunteer and Reward (V&R), and SocialFi models, helping charities grasp the potential of Web3. The platform brings together charities, NGOs, social enterprises, and donors to contribute to society, guiding them on how to use Web3 to boost donor engagement and visibility. It supports efforts toward the 17 UN Global Goals.
